   3.1. Include all patients meeting the entry criteria regardless of age, sex, race/ethnicity, or prior observation time.
   3.2. No requirement for continuous enrollment or minimum prior observation time.
   3.3. No restriction to care setting (ambulatory, emergency, inpatient, laboratory-only, etc.).

WITH
measurement_positive AS (
  SELECT
    m.person_id,
    DATE(m.measurement_date) AS event_date,
    'measurement' AS event_type,
    m.measurement_id AS event_id
  FROM `project.dataset.measurement` m
  LEFT JOIN `project.dataset.concept` c
    ON m.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE DATE(m.measurement_date) BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
    -- restrict to measurements plausibly representing SARS-CoV-2 tests
    AND (
      (c.concept_id IS NOT NULL AND (
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%sars%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'))
      OR
      (LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%sars%')
    )
    -- require a positive/detected result (value_as_string/value_source_value or mapped result concept)
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_as_string, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_as_string, '')) LIKE '%detect%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value, '')) LIKE '%detect%' OR
      -- include mapped result concepts whose concept_name indicates positivity
      (m.value_as_concept_id IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_concept_id IN (
        SELECT concept_id FROM `project.dataset.concept` WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(concept_name, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(concept_name, '')) LIKE '%detect%'
      ))
    )
),
condition_covid AS (
  SELECT
    co.person_id,
    DATE(co.condition_start_date) AS event_date,
    'condition' AS event_type,
    co.condition_occurrence_id AS event_id
  FROM `project.dataset.condition_occurrence` co
  LEFT JOIN `project.dataset.concept` c
    ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE DATE(co.condition_start_date) BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
    -- include conditions mapped to COVID-19 or with source codes/names indicating COVID-19
    AND (
      (c.concept_id IS NOT NULL AND (
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'
      ))
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(co.condition_source_value, '')) LIKE '%covid%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(co.condition_source_value, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'
      OR co.condition_source_value IN ('U07.1','B97.29','B34.2')
      OR c.concept_code IN ('U07.1','B97.29','B34.2')
    )
),
all_events AS (
  SELECT * FROM measurement_positive
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM condition_covid
),
first_event_per_person AS (
  SELECT
    person_id,
    event_date AS cohort_start_date,
    event_date AS cohort_end_date,
    event_type,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY event_date, event_type) AS rn
  FROM all_events
)
SELECT
  1 AS cohort_definition_id,
  person_id AS subject_id,
  cohort_start_date,
  cohort_end_date,
  event_type AS source_event_type,
  event_id AS source_event_id
FROM first_event_per_person
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH
measurement_positive AS (
  SELECT
    m.person_id,
    DATE(m.measurement_date) AS event_date,
    'measurement' AS event_type,
    m.measurement_id AS event_id
  FROM `project.dataset.measurement` m
  LEFT JOIN `project.dataset.concept` c
    ON m.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE DATE(m.measurement_date) BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
    -- restrict to measurements plausibly representing SARS-CoV-2 tests
    AND (
      (c.concept_id IS NOT NULL AND (
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%sars%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'))
      OR
      (LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(m.measurement_source_value, '')) LIKE '%sars%')
    )
    -- require a positive/detected result (value_as_string/value_source_value or mapped result concept)
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_as_string, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_as_string, '')) LIKE '%detect%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value, '')) LIKE '%detect%' OR
      -- include mapped result concepts whose concept_name indicates positivity
      (m.value_as_concept_id IS NOT NULL AND m.value_as_concept_id IN (
        SELECT concept_id FROM `project.dataset.concept` WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(concept_name, '')) LIKE '%posit%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(concept_name, '')) LIKE '%detect%'
      ))
    )
),
condition_covid AS (
  SELECT
    co.person_id,
    DATE(co.condition_start_date) AS event_date,
    'condition' AS event_type,
    co.condition_occurrence_id AS event_id
  FROM `project.dataset.condition_occurrence` co
  LEFT JOIN `project.dataset.concept` c
    ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
  WHERE DATE(co.condition_start_date) BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2021-12-31'
    -- include conditions mapped to COVID-19 or with source codes/names indicating COVID-19
    AND (
      (c.concept_id IS NOT NULL AND (
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%covid%' OR
         LOWER(COALESCE(c.concept_name, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'
      ))
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(co.condition_source_value, '')) LIKE '%covid%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(co.condition_source_value, '')) LIKE '%coronavirus%'
      OR co.condition_source_value IN ('U07.1','B97.29','B34.2')
      OR c.concept_code IN ('U07.1','B97.29','B34.2')
    )
),
all_events AS (
  SELECT * FROM measurement_positive
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM condition_covid
),
first_event_per_person AS (
  SELECT
    person_id,
    event_date AS cohort_start_date,
    event_date AS cohort_end_date,
    event_type,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY event_date, event_type) AS rn
  FROM all_events
)
SELECT
  1 AS cohort_definition_id,
  person_id AS subject_id,
  cohort_start_date,
  cohort_end_date,
  event_type AS source_event_type,
  event_id AS source_event_id
FROM first_event_per_person
WHERE rn = 1;
